kai: Quick FYI — discovered SDK 2.7.0 <> runtime 3.2.1 flaky interaction on long-seq streaming during nightly CI. Planning a regionwise soft-unpin tonight 23:00 UTC to limit blast radius.

mira: how bad are the failures? customer-facing?

kai: only failing integration tests so far (internal), no support tickets. Root is KV-cache ordering when client uses streaming+function-calls.

samir: can you paste the failing assertion?

kai: here's a trimmed log snippet: ```
ERROR stream: kv-order-mismatch token_idx=1024 model=llama3q runtime=3.2.1 sdk=2.7.0
stack: runtime/kv_cache.go:234 -> runtime/stream.go:112 -> sdk/stream_client.go:88
```

mira: ok — suggestion: unpin in a staggered order by region (low-traffic -> high), smoke after each step. ap-south -> eu-west -> us-west -> us-east. 15m gap between regions.

ops_jun: +1. I'll run the deploy-bot commands and monitor. deploy-bot, please follow the sequence and post job ids here.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.2.1 --model llama3q --regions ap-south --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6159995001). Will post status updates.

samir: rollback criteria proposal: revert if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency regresses > 10% for 5m after smoke queries. Also abort if integration test failures reappear.

mira: add a quick smoke script for post-unpin verification: ```
# smoke.sh
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"
    -d '{"model":"llama3q","input":"streaming test\n--long--seq","stream":true}'
  || { echo "smoke fail"; exit 1; }
done
```

eng-qa: we'll run the smoke in ap-south and report within 10m of completion.

deploy-bot: ap-south unpin complete (job=JB6159995001) — status=OK.

ops_jun: ap-south smoke start in 1m. If green, proceed to eu-west.

samir: prepping rollback playbook & release-note blurb: "We temporarily unpinned runtime 3.2.1 in staggered regions due to an SDK long-seq streaming incompatibility; customers on affected models may experience transient errors while we validate. A rollback will be triggered if smoke thresholds fail." Will paste final blurb once eu-west is done.

mira: reminder: tag @support on the announcement and cc eng-sre if we trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: eu-west unpin started (job=JB6159995002).

eng-qa: ap-south smoke: all 3 runs passed, p95 within baseline, no 5xx.

ops_jun: proceeding to eu-west now, watch channel for deploy-bot updates.

deploy-bot: eu-west unpin complete (job=JB6159995002) — status=OK; us-west queued (job=JB6159995003).

samir: eu-west smoke in progress. If anything pops, I'll trigger rollback command: `pin runtime 3.2.1 --scope region=eu-west --force`

mira: good. If eu-west is green after 15m, escalate to us-west then us-east.

eng-qa: eu-west smoke: one flaky run with a stream disconnect, investigating — saving logs to ticket INF-4522.

ops_jun: hold us-west until INF-4522 verdict.

samir: if INF-4522 shows SDK repro, we hold and patch SDK; else we continue.

mira: noted. Thanks all — leave this thread open for final decision.

deploy-bot: us-west unpin cancelled (job=JB6159995003) per hold request.

ops_jun: final — we're pausing the staggered unpin. Ticket INF-4522 opened, rollback plan on standby. I'll update the release notes draft and ping @support once we have an RCA. :eyes:
